items.title: Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Oneonta, New York, December 28, 2005
items.q: Yeah. Ray Crisara, trumpet, Charlie Margulis, and a great xylophonist and timpanist, George Gaber.

ctx.x: Yeah. Ray Crisara, trumpet, Charlie Margulis, and a great xylophonist and timpanist, George Gaber. He is one of the greatest timpanist/percussionists in the world. He went to Bloomington, Indiana, thirty years ago. And he’s still alive. He’s there. He’s one of the greatest. Things he could do with the timpanis you know, made different sounds. Yeah. George Gaber.
When you did an album in those days, how long did it take to do an album?
